front: Main sections of a design doc?
back: Context, goals and non-goals, proposal, alternatives, evaluation, risks, rollout and cost, open questions.
They stop scope growth and make trade-offs visible.
Choose criteria, set weights first, score options 1 to 5, multiply and sum, add must-have filters, check sensitivity.
Diagnosis of the real problem, a guiding policy that excludes some actions, and coherent actions.
A record of each decision with date, reasons, people and a revisit date, so old arguments do not return.

front: How to run a design review?
back: Send the doc early, ask specific questions, discuss disagreements only, name a decider and a date.
